visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a white peasant blouse and brown skirt stands in a sun-dappled park, crying loudly with an exaggerated, distressed facial expression. She holds a bow and arrow. (2) An animated sequence shows a young boy's head superimposed on a cartoon sun against a bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds. (3) A close-up of the woman's face reveals dark freckles/spots on her nose and cheeks; she looks directly into the lens with a look of horror. (4) The woman is seen in a rapid montage shooting her bow at sun targets in various outdoor settings, including a stone path, a rope bridge, and a red playground slide. (5) In a garden setting, the woman carries a man wearing a black-and-white panda mask on her shoulders while aiming her bow upwards. (6) A young boy wearing traditional-style robes appears next to her, talking to the camera with a playful expression while she reacts with shock. (7) Transition to a clean studio environment where the woman, now dressed in a white dress, speaks directly to the camera, using hand gestures to explain skin care concepts. (8) Close-up shots of a purple bottle of La Roche-Posay Mela B3 serum being held and applied to skin. (9) Before and after comparison images show skin with and without spots, using circular highlighting overlays to show improvements. (10) Technical documents and reports are briefly shown to provide scientific context, followed by the woman returning to the studio frame to give a thumbs up.

(2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX triggers a transition to a high-tempo, upbeat electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 beat. (3) Rapid 'thud' and 'impact' SFX occur in sync with arrows hitting targets, accompanied by comic 'ding' sounds. (4) The female voice transitions from comedic shouting to a steady, clear, and professional narrative tone, maintaining a high speech rate. (5) Sounds of a plastic cap clicking and the light viscous 'squish' of a serum bottle being used are audible over the BGM.
